title: `EditorExportPlatform` Errors when exporting unsupported filetypes in Dedicated Server export configuration
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.7.dev5, 4.6.x ### System information Godot v4.7.beta.mono (e1d1372ed) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21030.2001) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.11 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Whenever I add any unsupported filetype in the `res://` and try to export it as Dedicated Server, I get errors such as: ```  ERROR: No loader found for resource: res://Shared/Prototypes/base.jsonc (expected type: unknown)  ERROR: [editor\export\editor_export_platform.cpp:1095](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/editor/export/editor_export_platform.cpp#L1095) - Condition "res.is_null()" is true. Returning: p_path  ERROR: No loader found for resource: res://Shared/Prototypes/entity_prototypes.jsonc (expected type: unknown)  ERROR: [editor\export\editor_export_platform.cpp:1095](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/editor/export/editor_export_platform.cpp#L1095) - Condition "res.is_null()" is true. Returning: p_path  ERROR: No loader found for resource: res://Shared/Prototypes/funnyFile.funny (expected type: unknown)  ERROR: [editor\export\editor_export_platform.cpp:1095](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/editor/export/editor_export_platform.cpp#L1095) - Condition "res.is_null()" is true. Returning: p_path ``` Server Export configuration: **However this error does not happen when exporting as anything else, it works just fine on my Client Export configuration.** Even if I use "Keep" or "Remove" in `Resources to override export behavior:` it still errors # NOTE: Error seems to be cosmetic, since it does not affect the final build, Im still able to use and work with my .jsonc files after exporting, ### Steps to reproduce * add any unsupported filetype to the res:// (in my case its .jsonc) * in the export resource configuration, make sure to include the `.jsonc` (or any non-resource files) * export project as Dedicated Server * check the output for errors ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) https://github.com/codebykoi/.jsonctesting
